verdict.rationale: React is fully open-source (MIT licensed) code that can be downloaded, run, and served entirely from one's own infrastructure — it has no proprietary SaaS backend, and can render server-side via Node with no external dependency (react-gh-1, react-docs-6, react-gh-2). Community evidence confirms the MIT relicensing removed the patent-clause restrictions that previously blocked full self-hosting/redistribution (react-comm-1, react-comm-3, react-comm-5). Missing for 10: no dedicated self-hosting/deployment documentation or independent report of a fully self-hosted React stack (vs. using Vercel/Next.js hosted services).
